speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Can you describe the nature of your flank pain—is it dull, sharp, or colicky—and on which side is it located?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, and have you noticed any changes in the color or frequency of your urine? Please also let me know if you have experienced any nausea or vomiting.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear on your trunk or extremities, and have you experienced any joint pain or dark urine since starting the new antibiotic? I need to rule out serum sickness-like reaction or drug-induced interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
